create_bluebubbles_adapter: create a BlueBubblesAdapter instance configured with server URL and password for iMessage integration
send_text_message: send a text message via BlueBubbles to a chat identified by phone number or email address
send_media_attachment: send an image, voice, video, or document attachment to a BlueBubbles chat with optional caption
handle_inbound_webhook: handle an inbound BlueBubbles webhook that parses incoming iMessage events and triggers message handling
download_inbound_attachment: download an inbound iMessage attachment from BlueBubbles and cache it locally by MIME type
